text: シオン　タウンで　ゆうれい　ポケモンが　でるって　みんな　さわいでるよ

structure.jp: シオン　タウンで　ゆうれい　ポケモンが　でるって
structure.en: that ghost Pokémon appear in Lavender Town

structure.jp: みんな　さわいでるよ

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: って is the casual form of と, put after the words that people are saying. でるって = 'saying that they appear'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: でる is the shortened form of でいる, which says the action is going on now. さわいでる = 'are making a fuss'.
